questions.explanation: It-clefts start with 'It was' to emphasize the subject.
questions.q: ___ was John who broke the window.

questions.explanation: In what-clefts, 'what' takes a singular verb: 'What I need is...'.
questions.q: What I need ___ a good night's sleep.

questions.explanation: It-clefts use 'who' for people and match the past tense: 'It was... who approved'.
options: It is the manager who approved the budget yesterday.
It was the manager which approved the budget yesterday.
It was the manager who approved the budget yesterday.
It was the manager whom approved the budget yesterday.
questions.q: Choose the correct sentence.

questions.explanation: It-clefts use 'that' (not 'where') after the emphasized element.
questions.q: It was in Paris ___ we first met.

questions.explanation: All-clefts follow 'All + subject + verb + is': 'All I want is...'.
questions.q: All I ___ is a little respect.

questions.explanation: It-clefts use 'that' for things: 'It was the delay that caused...'.
questions.q: It was the delay ___ caused all the problems.

questions.explanation: In what-clefts, 'what' is singular: 'What bothers me is...'.
questions.q: What ___ me is his attitude.

questions.explanation: The cleft matches the past event: 'It was she who organized'.
questions.q: It ___ she who organized the whole event.

questions.explanation: What-clefts take a singular verb after 'what': 'What we need is...'.
questions.q: What we need ___ more time.

questions.explanation: The what-cleft uses the singular 'is' after 'what'.
options: What I want are some peace and quiet.
What I want is some peace and quietly.
What I want is some peace and quiet.
What do I want is some peace and quiet.
questions.q: Choose the correct sentence.

questions.explanation: It-clefts use 'that' after time expressions: 'It was last week that...'.
questions.q: It was only last week ___ I heard the news.

questions.explanation: All-clefts use 'All + subject + verb': 'All he did was complain'.
questions.q: All ___ did was complain.

questions.explanation: It-clefts use 'that' for things, even in negative clefts.
questions.q: It wasn't the money ___ mattered.

questions.explanation: What-clefts take the singular verb 'is'.
questions.q: What really matters ___ his honesty.

questions.explanation: It-clefts use 'that', not 'which': 'It was in 1990 that it happened'.
options: It was in 1990 which it happened.
questions.q: Find the sentence with a mistake.

questions.explanation: Emphasize with an it-cleft: 'It is hard work that brings success'.
questions.q: It is hard work ___ brings success.

questions.explanation: The what-cleft takes a singular verb: 'What he said was...'.
questions.q: What he said ___ complete nonsense.

questions.explanation: It-clefts use 'who' for the emphasized person.
questions.q: It was the assistant ___ prepared the slides.

questions.explanation: This cleft ('The thing... is...') uses the singular 'is'.
options: The thing I hate are traffic jams.
The thing I hate it is traffic jams.
The thing what I hate is traffic jams.
The thing I hate is traffic jams.
questions.q: Choose the correct sentence.

questions.explanation: What-clefts take the singular verb 'is'.
questions.q: What worries me ___ the rising costs.
